sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:28

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:28:1
items.html: Yet, the end of their work was afterwards when the Orot returned to come down a second descent. It is so because then the Hitzoniut of their Kelim is completed and the Orot are also permanently diminished there. This is because only Ohr Hochma comes to Kli de Keter and Ohr Bina to Kli de Hochma etc. That completes their Behinat Kelim.
